subject: Model fit & safety probes — AlderHealth discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ferris <samantha.ferris@alderhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model fit & safety probes — AlderHealth discovery follow-up

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can move to a short evaluation cycle that addresses both model-fit and the safety/refusal behavior you called out.

Recap (30min call):
- Primary use case: triage-assist and patient-facing FAQ summarization for non-urgent care.
- Data footprint: de-identified encounter summaries + clinical taxonomy mapping (you estimated ~5k monthly docs).
- Concerns: PHI leakage, medical advice hallucinations, and regulatory auditability.

Proposed evaluation plan (2 weeks):
1) Model shortlist & config (week 1):
   - Candidate A: Llama-2-70b-chat (8-bit quantized) — baseline for high-coverage clinical knowledge.
   - Candidate B: Redwood-7B-clinical-q4f — lower-cost, tuned for refusal/guardrail behavior.
   - Candidate C: Ensembled approach (B for default, A fallback for low-confidence).
2) Benchmarks & probes (parallel):
   - Clinical accuracy: 500-sample gold set (we'll work with your SME).
   - Refusal tests: 200 prompts targeting PHI exfiltration, drug-prescription, and self-harm content.
   - Latency/cost: 95th percentile under expected concurrency (5 qps/user, pilot ~10 users).
3) Safety validation (week 2):
   - Prompt guardrail matrix (we'll run your promptset + our open prompt probes).
   - Policy behavior checks and refusal-rate targets (aim: <=1% false-negatives on PHI probes).

Attachments included (placeholders): alderhealth-sample-promptset.jsonl, Alder_Data_Schema.csv, redwood-benchmark-summary.pdf

What we need from you to get started:
- A 150–300 item sample of de-identified examples (or a small synthetic dump) for the gold set.
- Point of contact for security/compliance (SOC2 evidence request) — copied Kevin if that's the right person.
- Any hard SLAs on latency or throughput we should bake into the pilot config.

Suggested immediate next steps:
- I can kick off a short technical workshop (45 minutes) with Marissa (inference lead) + Ben (solutions) this week if you can share the sample.
- We’ll provision a sandbox project in our Dedicated test pool and share an evaluation dashboard + Drive folder for artifacts.

If that looks right I’ll send a calendar invite with a proposed timeline.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Subject: Re: Model fit & safety probes — AlderHealth discovery follow-up

Hi Priyom — appreciate the clear plan and timeline. A few quick items:

- That shortlist looks reasonable; cost is a key constraint so we’re very interested in the Redwoods-7B option if it meets accuracy targets.
- Kevin is our procurement lead (cc'd) and our security team (security@alderhealth.com) will want the SOC2 artifacts and an engineer-to-engineer security runthrough.
- Two items to flag: (1) our latency target for the patient-facing FAQ is 300ms p95, (2) we cannot send any real PHI outside our VPC — can you confirm a Private deployment sandbox or synthetic-only evaluation?

I can pull a 200-item synthetic sample by EOD Thursday. Kevin — can your team help with procurement timelines and whether AlderHealth requires an MSA before a sandbox?

Best,
Samantha
Head of Digital Services | AlderHealth
samantha.ferris@alderhealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model fit & safety probes — AlderHealth discovery follow-up

Samantha — great, thanks. Quick replies inline:

- Private sandbox: yes — we can spin up a Private deployment sandbox in your VPC for the evaluation so no real PHI leaves your network. Marissa will own the deployment config and audit log exports.
- Latency: 300ms p95 for patient FAQ is aggressive but feasible with the ensemble plan + tuned batching and a small cache for common Q&A. We’ll include p95 targets in the pilot SLA and instrument token-level traces.
- SOC2 & security: attaching the SOC2 certificate link and a short security checklist — Marissa will set a 30–45 minute review with your security engineer.

Proposed timeline (condensed):
- Thu 9/10: technical workshop (45m) and validation of sample schema.
- Fri 9/11–Mon 9/14: run model-fit and refusal probes on synthetic sample + our probe set.
- Tue 9/15: shared dashboard with quick wins + suggested guardrail prompts.

Benchmarks & links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AlderShared/eval-suite (we'll drop detailed run results here)
- Quick benchmark summary: redwood-benchmark-summary.pdf (attached)

I’ll send calendar invites for Thu + the security review. If Kevin confirms procurement needs an MSA first we’ll share a template MSA and we can run a short redlines pass.

Thanks,
Priyom
